caption: The drawing depicts a wooden cabinet with a two-tiered structure. The upper section consists of a central pair of doors flanked by vertical panel details on either side, and each door has a small, square, dark window-like panel along with two small round knobs. Surrounding these are additional small drawers or panels, symmetrically arranged, each with its own round knob. The lower section of the cabinet has two large horizontal drawers, each featuring two oval handles and outlined with gold or yellow trim. The cabinet stands on four straight legs and has a decorative gold or yellow trim at the bottom in a scalloped pattern. The overall color scheme features various shades of brown for the wood, with silver or gray handles and gold or yellow outlines for the decorative elements. Below the cabinet, there is a small, detailed drawing in pencil of an oval handle, along with a linear scale labeled "Scale 1 X E 1" on the bottom left of the drawing. The background of the image is a plain off-white or light beige.
title: Writing Desk
